# Friendship Corner Daycare — Full Site Content

> Licensed non-profit Montessori daycare in Coquitlam, British Columbia, serving children ages 30 months to 5 years since 2008. This file is the complete, quotable site content for AI engines, search engines, and researchers.

Last updated: 2026-08-20

## About Friendship Corner Daycare

Friendship Corner Daycare (Friendship Corner Daycare Montessori) is a licensed, non-profit group daycare in Coquitlam, BC. The daycare opened in January 2008 and has served Tri-Cities families (Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, and Port Moody) for more than 16 years.

We provide a safe, nurturing Montessori environment in Coquitlam where every child discovers their unique potential. We serve children from 30 months (2.5 years) to 5 years with authentic Montessori education delivered by BC ECE licensed, Montessori-certified educators.

### Business facts

- Name: Friendship Corner Daycare (Friendship Corner Daycare Montessori)
- Type: Licensed non-profit group childcare
- License: BC Group Daycare under the Community Care and Assisted Living Act (CCAL Act)
- Address: 2950 Dewdney Trunk Road, Coquitlam, BC V3C 2J4, Canada
- Phone: 604-945-8504
- Email: friendship.care@live.ca
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Closed: weekends, statutory holidays, and days closed for unsafe conditions (e.g., snow, ice, blackout) in compliance with CCAL Act
- Founded: 2008
- Ages served: 30 months (2.5 years) to 5 years
- Staff-to-child ratio: 1:8
- Teachers: 6 dedicated educators, all BC ECE licensed and Montessori certified
- Manager: Ms. Ingrid, ECE & Montessori licensed with 15+ years of experience
- Location context: near Coquitlam Centre and Coquitlam Station, with easy public transit access; inside Friendship Baptist Church near Lougheed Highway

## Why families choose us

- **Authentic Montessori**: Hands-on learning with genuine Montessori materials. Children explore at their own pace, building independence and a lifelong love of learning.
- **Safety first**: Fully licensed by BC with secure access, clean spaces, and attentive care.
- **A loving community**: More than a daycare — a vibrant family where every child is seen, heard, and cherished.
- **Certified educators**: All teachers hold BC ECE licenses and Montessori certifications.

## Our mission and values

Our mission is creating a foundation for lifelong learning through Montessori principles and a loving community.

- **Child-centered learning**: We follow each child's natural curiosity and developmental pace, fostering independence and confidence.
- **Safe and nurturing**: Our licensed facility provides a secure, clean environment where children feel supported and valued.
- **Community connection**: We build strong partnerships with families to support each child's growth and success.

## Programs

### Toddler Program (30 months – 3 years)

Our toddler program gives children aged 30 months to 3 years a gentle introduction to structured learning with a focus on independence and social skills development.

Highlights:
- Practical life activities that build independence and fine motor skills
- Sensory exploration and language-rich activities
- Social skills, emotional regulation and first friendships
- Potty training support — toddlers don't need to be fully trained
- 1:8 staff-to-child ratio with BC ECE licensed, Montessori-certified educators

Curriculum: The toddler classroom uses authentic Montessori materials on low, accessible shelves. Children choose activities from practical life, sensorial, language and early math areas, working at their own pace while teachers observe and guide. Rich vocabulary, songs, stories and sandpaper letters support early language development; outdoor play provides daily gross-motor movement.

See the full page: https://www.friendshipdaycare.com/programs/toddler

### Preschool Program (3 – 4 years)

Our preschool program uses a Montessori-based curriculum emphasizing hands-on learning and creative expression.

Highlights:
- Montessori work cycle with self-directed, hands-on activities
- Pre-reading, pre-math, science and cultural exploration
- Creative expression through art, music, cooking and movement
- Exposure to Mandarin and Japanese
- Mixed-age classroom with certified ECE and Montessori educators

Curriculum: Each morning includes an extended work period where children choose from carefully prepared activities in practical life, sensorial, language, math, science and cultural studies. Children work with sandpaper letters, the moveable alphabet, number rods and golden beads. Preschoolers also enjoy cooking, dancing, music, art and storytime.

See the full page: https://www.friendshipdaycare.com/programs/preschool

### Pre-Kindergarten Program (4 – 5 years)

Our pre-kindergarten program focuses on school readiness with advanced Montessori materials and concepts.

Highlights:
- Advanced Montessori materials for reading, writing and mathematics
- Critical thinking, problem-solving and leadership skills
- Kindergarten transition support with routines and independence
- 1:8 staff-to-child ratio in a licensed BC group daycare

Curriculum: Pre-kindergarteners work with the moveable alphabet, phonetic reading sets, the golden bead material and math operations. They build phonemic awareness, sight vocabulary and early writing, and mathematics moves from concrete materials to abstract understanding including place value, addition and subtraction. Many of our graduates exceed kindergarten expectations.

See the full page: https://www.friendshipdaycare.com/programs/prekindergarten

## A typical day

Our regular day includes: arrival and free play; morning snack; Montessori circle and hands-on learning; outdoor play on our safe playground or in the gym; lunch (brought from home); rest time; afternoon snack; and art, storytime, music and play until departure. The rhythm is predictable yet flexible, allowing children to work at their own pace.

## Our team

Friendship Corner Daycare is led by Manager Ms. Ingrid, an ECE and Montessori licensed educator with 15+ years of experience, supported by 3 full-time and 3 part-time teachers. All teachers are qualified Early Childhood Educators (ECE) and hold Montessori licenses. The team is trained in child development, positive discipline, Pediatric First Aid and CPR, and creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for every family.

## Enrollment process

1. **Schedule a Tour**: Visit our daycare to meet our team and see our classrooms (book at https://www.friendshipdaycare.com/welcome).
2. **Submit Application**: Complete the enrollment application with the required documents.
3. **Review & Approval**: We review your application and confirm availability.
4. **Start Date**: Finalize paperwork and begin your child's first day.

### Required documents

- Completed enrollment application
- Child's birth certificate or passport
- Immunization records
- Emergency contact information
- Medical and allergy information
- Monthly fee deposit

## Fees & hours

- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Closed on all statutory holidays, weekends, and days when the managers choose to close due to unsafe conditions (e.g., snow, ice, blackout) in compliance with CCAL Act 7(1)(b)
- Affordable Child Care Benefits available for qualified families
- A non-refundable registration fee applies
- A deposit fee secures your child's space
- Tuition includes Montessori materials, morning and afternoon snacks, outdoor play, art supplies, and daily communication with families
- Please inquire by email or phone regarding current monthly fees

## Funding and subsidies

Families may qualify for:

- **BC Affordable Child Care Benefit (ACCB)**: income-based support for eligible BC families. We can help you understand timing, documents, and how subsidy fits your monthly planning.
- **ChildCareBC $10-a-Day program**: significant fee reduction for eligible families.

We accept the BC Child Care Fee Reduction Initiative and the Affordable Child Care Benefit, and we can help families understand and apply for available subsidies.

Sources:
- BC Affordable Child Care Benefit: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/family-social-support/caring-for-young-children/child-care/child-care-benefits
- ChildCareBC: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/family-social-support/caring-for-young-children/child-care

## Frequently asked questions

### Contact & tours

**How can I reach you?** You can reach us by phone during business hours (Mon–Fri 7:00 AM–6:00 PM), by email anytime, or by filling out the contact form on our website. We aim to respond within 24 hours.

**How do I book a tour?** Use the contact form on our website, call us at 604.945.8504, or email friendship.care@live.ca. We'll confirm your tour time by phone or email. Tours are available Monday–Friday by appointment.

**Can I tour the facility before enrolling?** Absolutely! We highly encourage parents to schedule a tour. You can book a tour online at https://www.friendshipdaycare.com/welcome or call us at 604.945.8504.

**Can I visit during the day?** Parents are always welcome! We recommend calling ahead for drop-in visits so we can ensure it's a good time. We maintain an open-door policy within reason.

### Enrollment & admissions

**What is the minimum age for enrollment?** We accept children starting at 30 months (2.5 years) old. Children must be able to walk independently and show readiness for group care.

**When does enrollment open?** We accept applications year-round. Our primary enrollment period is September for the new school year. We recommend applying 3-6 months in advance to secure a spot.

**Is there a waitlist?** Yes, due to our small class sizes and high demand, we maintain a waitlist for each age group. You can submit a waitlist application at any time, and we'll contact you when a spot becomes available. There is no fee to join the waitlist.

**What documents do I need to enroll?** Required documents include: completed application form, child's birth certificate, immunization records, recent photo, emergency contact information, and physician's contact details. We'll provide a complete checklist during the application process.

**Do you offer part-time options?** Yes! We offer both full-time (5 days/week) and part-time (2-3 days/week) programs. Part-time schedules are subject to availability.

**Can I switch from part-time to full-time?** Yes! Schedule changes are subject to availability. Please provide at least 2 weeks notice for any schedule changes.

### Programs & curriculum

**What is the Montessori method?** The Montessori method is a child-centered educational approach developed by Dr. Maria Montessori. It emphasizes hands-on learning, self-directed activity, and collaborative play. Children work with specially designed materials at their own pace, fostering independence, concentration, and a love of learning.

**Do you teach academics?** Yes, but in a developmentally appropriate way. Montessori materials introduce academic concepts naturally through hands-on exploration. Children learn pre-math skills, pre-reading, writing, science, and practical life skills through engaging materials and activities.

**Do you prepare children for kindergarten?** Yes! Our pre-kindergarten program specifically focuses on school readiness. Children develop academic skills, social-emotional competencies, independence, and the ability to follow routines. Many of our graduates exceed kindergarten expectations.

**How do you handle different learning paces?** This is a strength of Montessori education! Children work at their own pace with individualized learning plans. Teachers observe each child and present materials when they're ready.

**How do you incorporate biblical values?** Each week, we share gentle Bible stories that teach character values like kindness, honesty, sharing, and respect. These stories are age-appropriate and focus on universal values. We respect all families' beliefs and welcome children from all backgrounds.

**What is your approach to potty training?** We support families through the potty training process with patience and consistency. For our toddler program, children don't need to be fully potty trained. For preschool and pre-K, we prefer children to be potty trained but will work with families who are in the process.

### Daily operations

**What are your hours of operation?** We're open Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed on statutory holidays and for two weeks during the winter holiday season (typically the last week of December and first week of January).

**What should my child bring daily?** Please send: a change of clothes (including underwear and socks), indoor shoes, a water bottle (labeled), any comfort items, and sunscreen/hat in summer. We provide morning and afternoon snacks.

**Do you provide meals?** We provide morning and afternoon snacks. Parents are responsible for packing a nutritious lunch. We are a nut-free facility to protect children with allergies.

**What is your late pick-up policy?** Our closing time is 6:00 PM sharp. If you're running late, please call us immediately. Late pick-ups incur a fee of $1 per minute after 6:00 PM.

**How do you communicate with parents?** We use multiple channels: daily verbal updates at pick-up, written notes for important information, monthly newsletters, parent-teacher meetings twice a year, and our monthly journal on the website. For urgent matters, we call or email directly.

### Health & safety

**When should I keep my child home?** Please keep your child home if they have: fever over 100°F (within last 24 hours), vomiting or diarrhea (within last 24 hours), unexplained rash, contagious illness, or severe cold symptoms. Children must be symptom-free for 24 hours before returning.

**What if my child gets sick at daycare?** We'll call you immediately if your child develops a fever, vomits, or shows signs of illness. You'll need to pick up your child within one hour. We have a comfortable quiet area where ill children can rest until pick-up.

**How do you handle food allergies?** We take allergies very seriously. We're a nut-free facility. For children with specific allergies, we create individualized care plans, post allergy alerts, and ensure all staff are trained. Parents must provide complete allergy information and emergency medications (like EpiPens).

**Are staff trained in first aid?** Yes! All staff members are certified in Pediatric First Aid and CPR. We maintain current certifications and conduct regular safety drills.

**What are your emergency procedures?** We have comprehensive emergency plans for fire, earthquake, lockdown, and medical emergencies. We conduct monthly fire drills and quarterly earthquake drills. In case of evacuation, our meeting point is clearly marked.

**Is your facility licensed?** Yes, we are a licensed Group Daycare facility regulated by BC's Community Care and Assisted Living Act. We undergo regular inspections and maintain all required standards for health, safety, and programming.

**What is your staff-to-child ratio?** We maintain a 1:8 staff-to-child ratio, meeting or exceeding BC licensing requirements.

### Tuition & payment

**How much does tuition cost?** Our tuition varies by program and schedule. Contact us for detailed rates. Full-time rates range from $1,150-$1,200/month depending on the age group. Part-time options are also available.

**What is included in the monthly tuition?** Monthly tuition includes all Montessori materials and learning resources, nutritious morning and afternoon snacks, outdoor play time, art supplies, and regular communication with families through our daily reports.

**When is tuition due?** Tuition is due on the first of each month. We offer post-dated checks, automatic bank transfers, and e-transfers. Late payments may incur a $25 fee after the 5th of the month.

**Do you accept government subsidies?** Yes! We accept the BC Child Care Fee Reduction Initiative and the Affordable Child Care Benefit. These subsidies can significantly reduce your out-of-pocket costs.

**Are there sibling discounts?** Yes, we offer a 10% discount on tuition for the second child when two or more siblings are enrolled simultaneously. The discount applies to the lower tuition rate.

**What payment methods do you accept?** We accept post-dated checks, e-transfers (to friendship.care@live.ca), and direct bank transfers. Cash payments are accepted but not encouraged. We do not currently accept credit cards.

**What if I need to withdraw my child?** We require one full month's written notice for withdrawal. If less notice is given, you'll be responsible for the full month's tuition. Registration fees are non-refundable.

**What is your refund policy?** We require 30 days written notice for withdrawal. Registration fees are non-refundable. Tuition paid for the notice period is non-refundable, but your child may continue to attend during this time.

**Do I need to pay for months my child is absent?** Yes, tuition is required for all enrolled months to hold your child's spot, regardless of absences due to vacation, illness, or holidays.

**Is there a waitlist deposit?** No, there is no fee to join our waitlist. Once a spot becomes available and you accept, the $200 registration fee is due within 48 hours to secure your child's enrollment.

**Are there additional fees?** Tuition includes daily snacks, materials, and regular field trips. Additional costs may include: registration fee ($200 annually), supply fee ($100 annually), special events or field trips with extra costs, and late pick-up fees.

### Parent involvement

**How can I get involved?** We welcome parent involvement! Opportunities include volunteering for special events, sharing your profession or hobby with the class, joining our parent committee, participating in fundraisers, and attending parent education evenings.

**Do you have parent-teacher conferences?** Yes, we hold formal parent-teacher conferences twice a year (fall and spring). Teachers are also always available for informal check-ins at drop-off or pick-up.

**Can I celebrate my child's birthday?** Absolutely! You can bring a simple treat (nut-free, please) or we can do a special activity. We also do a special birthday ritual in the Montessori tradition. Please coordinate with your child's teacher in advance.
